tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App ground. Bone by day, vault-steel at night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Documents and ledgers: tables, panes, the invoice, the transcript.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Sidebar, the original-email well, citation tabs, MICR lines.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered ledger row and quiet button hover.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between rows and panes. Decorative; never a control's only border.

tokens.name: microline
tokens.usage: Security-print linework behind money and quoted evidence. Texture only.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons, the selected-row rule. 3.5:1 on surface, 3.2:1 on paper (light); 3.6:1 / 3.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Engraving ink. Body text, amounts, anything Callback states, on paper, surface and surface-sunk (≥14.5:1). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, column heads, passed checks, margin notes. ≥5.4:1 on paper, surface, surface-sunk and surface-hover in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholders only. Fails 4.5:1 on purpose.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Pay, Approve, Run payments). One per view. The main action is ink, not a hue.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Serial-number red: money stopped. Held marks, failed checks, the endorsement, the underline on suspicious words. On surface 6.9:1 / 7.2:1, paper 6.4:1 / 7.7:1, hold-tint 5.6:1 / 6.4:1.

tokens.name: hold-tint
tokens.usage: Held mark fill; the Not confirmed call band.

tokens.name: hold-solid
tokens.usage: Full-strength red: the failed-check square and the cover block. Text on it is on-hold (6.5:1 / 4.7:1).

tokens.name: on-hold
tokens.usage: Text on hold-solid.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Switchboard brass: a phone line is open. Calling mark text, the live timer. On surface 6.8:1 / 8.9:1, brass-tint 5.7:1 / 7.8:1.

tokens.name: brass-tint
tokens.usage: Calling mark fill and the live call band.

tokens.name: brass-solid
tokens.usage: The line indicator and the call waveform. A mark, not text (3.1:1 / 6.8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: signatory
tokens.usage: Signatory blue: people. Needs-you marks, sign-offs, a person's initials and quoted words. Never used by Callback. On surface 10.3:1 / 8.4:1, signatory-tint 8.6:1 / 7.4:1.

tokens.name: signatory-tint
tokens.usage: Needs-you mark fill; the Approvals count.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Provisional: the Checking mark and warn checks. On graphite-tint 6.3:1 / 7.7:1.

tokens.name: graphite-tint
tokens.usage: Checking mark fill.

tokens.name: paid
tokens.usage: Paid and Scheduled marks: outline only. The normal case is quiet.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles only: Inbox, Approvals, Payments. One per screen.

styles.name: subject
styles.usage: A bill's subject on its page; a supplier's name on theirs.

styles.name: signatory
styles.usage: A person's name on a sign-off, in signatory blue. Never Callback.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fogline has paid Stagecraft 11 times since April, always to Chase ··2210.
styles.usage: Default reading text, table cells, evidence, the other party's words on a call.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Supplier names in unread rows, check verdicts, actor names.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: No answer. Trying again at 2:15 PM.
styles.usage: Helper text, a locked button's reason, margin notes.

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: Status marks, ledger column heads, endorsement captions. The only uppercase in the product.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: The courtesy amount on a bill or approval. One per view.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Before I update anything — what was your September invoice number?
styles.usage: What Callback says or writes: its call lines, its replies, its log entries.

styles.name: record
styles.usage: Anything copied from a record: invoice numbers, MICR lines, phone numbers, transfer IDs, timecodes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to label inside a mark or button.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a verdict and its evidence; between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Ledger cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane padding; gap between checks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections; the transcript margin gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty states only.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status marks, citation tabs, MICR lines.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panes and popovers. The largest corner in the product.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Line indicators and people's initials only.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Every ledger row: Inbox, Payments, Approvals, Activity log.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons inside a row.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Left navigation.

tokens.name: evidence-width
tokens.usage: Right pane of the bill page.

tokens.name: margin-width
tokens.usage: The transcript's left margin for timecodes and sources.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: All rules. The product has one line weight besides the 1.5px ledger head rule.

tokens.name: shadow-doc
tokens.usage: A document resting on the desk: panes and the invoice. Nothing else is raised.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The Why? popover and menus.
